summary: BioLineRx filed a Form 6-K attaching its press release and unaudited financial statements for Q1 2026. The filing reports cash and cash runway guidance, updates on a GLIX1 clinical trial, and preclinical data. There is no transaction, merger, tender offer, activist campaign, or other special situation. This is a routine earnings release by a foreign private issuer, mapped to a domestic earnings press release. No deal terms or special-situations mechanics are present.
